8270: After witnessing the suicide bombing of a terrorist girl, Constable Kazuki Fuse becomes haunted by her image, and is forced to undergo retraining for his position in the Capital Police's Special Unit.
9063: Captain Tatsumi is the Commanding Officer of Tokki-Tai. Kerberos Panzer Cop reveals he is a founding member of the organization with Aniya. The organization was created five years before the events portrayed in the manga's first part.
32143: Hachiroh Tohbe is a senior instructor within the Kerberos Academy Training School. He once trained both Kazuki Fuse and Atsushi Henmi. Tohbe's secretly number 2 within the Jin-Roh hierarchy and the immediate superior to Kazuki Fuse. He appears in Kerberos Panzer Cop Part Two.
